episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing conflict between Compass, Zillow, and MLS over listing data control and its implications for real estate agents. He shares innovative AI-driven solutions to common industry challenges, such as deal cancellations and cold call reluctance. The episode offers valuable insights into leveraging technology to stay competitive in the evolving real estate landscape.
